annotations.title: Get a link to connect a brand's mailbox

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] A one-time link that connects the business's own Gmail, Microsoft or IMAP mailbox to the brand. Give it to the person who owns the mailbox: they open it signed in to flayr and approve with their provider. Optional `email` pre-fills the address; `reconnect: true` refreshes an expired connection.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/brands/{id}/mailbox/connect-link.)

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

name: brand_mailbox_connect_link
title: Get a link to connect a brand's mailbox
